# monthly-close-control-plane
> High-density context for LLM agents, financial controllers, and accounting automation pipelines.

## Package Overview
- **Repository**: https://github.com/ryanduguid/monthly-close-control-plane
- **CLI Commands**: `close-control`, `openaccountants-au`
- **Domain**: Deterministic monthly close control plane and integrity framework for verified trial balance exports.
- **Accounting Standards**: AASB 101 Presentation of Financial Statements, double-entry mathematical invariants.

## Core Modules & Controls
- `closecontrol.engine`: Core reconciliation validation engine evaluating balance invariant predicates across accounting periods.
- `closecontrol.validators`: Deterministic verification that debits equal credits, movement reconciles to year-to-date balances, and retained earnings align.
- `closecontrol.pipeline_cli`: Automation harness for multi-entity Australian accounting practice close workflows.

## Architectural Invariants
1. **Review-First Policy**: All reconciliation anomalies and trial balance discrepancies are surfaced transparently as structured review exceptions before period locking.
2. **Immutable Period Anchoring**: Historical closed periods are cryptographically verified against regression.
